weekly_theme.summary: 這段期間沒有特別重大的星象事件，是適合按自己步調安排生活的一週。

aries.horoscope: 牡羊座，全心全意擁抱你的熱情！與其在自助餐中品嚐所有食物而讓自己不知所措，不如專注於選擇一兩個您最喜歡的食物並充分品嚐它們。保存一些以供以後使用也是完全可以的。堅決反對任何讓你嘗試不讓你興奮的事情的勸說。只有您才能真正確定什麼可以滿足您的渴望。
aries.horoscope_en: Aries, embrace your passions wholeheartedly! Rather than overwhelming yourself by sampling everything at the buffet, focus on selecting one or two of your favorites and savor them to the fullest. It's perfectly fine to save some for later, too. Stand firm against any persuasion to try something that doesn't excite you. Only you can truly identify what satisfies your cravings.

taurus.horoscope: 金牛座，今天你可能會感覺自己打破了記錄。你經歷過一些坎坷和挫傷，現在你發現自己陷入了一個循環，不斷重申你的訊息，直到它引起共鳴。請記住，這不是您的錯，所以如果其他人似乎因您的堅持而不知所措，請不要擔心。事實上，這種重複可能正是每個人共同前進所需要的。
taurus.horoscope_en: Taurus, you might feel like a broken record today. You've faced some bumps and bruises, and now you find yourself stuck in a loop, reiterating your message until it resonates. Remember, this isn't your fault, so don't worry if others seem overwhelmed by your persistence. In fact, this repetition could be just what everyone needs to move forward together.

gemini.horoscope: 雙子座，你可能會發現自己面臨一些具有挑戰性的能量，挑戰你最深切的願望。與那些似乎有意破壞你樂觀情緒的人打交道時要小心。如果你讓他們的負面情緒滲透進來，你很容易會感到洩氣，就像氣球失氣一樣。避免任何可能影響你精神的工作場所衝突。記住，不要讓別人影響你內心的平靜。
gemini.horoscope_en: Gemini, you may find yourself facing some challenging energies that challenge your deepest aspirations. Tread carefully when dealing with those who seem intent on undermining your optimism. It’s easy to feel deflated, like a balloon losing air, if you let their negativity seep in. Steer clear of any workplace conflicts that could dampen your spirits. Remember, don’t allow others to affect your peace of mind.

cancer.horoscope: 巨蟹座，你發現自己處於一個非凡的位置，你可以抓住各種觀點的細微差別。與那些忽視大局的人相比，這種洞察力為你提供了顯著的優勢。然而，伴隨著這項優勢，指導他人的責任也隨之增加。相信你的直覺，知道什麼是正確的，並尋求方法來幫助你周圍的人理解你的觀點。
cancer.horoscope_en: Cancer, you find yourself in a remarkable spot where you can grasp the nuances of various viewpoints. This insight offers you a significant edge over those who remain oblivious to the bigger picture. However, with this advantage comes an increased duty to guide others. Trust your instincts about what is right, and seek ways to help those around you understand your perspective.

leo.horoscope: 獅子座，今天你可能會感到一些緊張。如果你即將迎來一個重要的約會，你可能會思緒萬千，思考如何給人留下持久的印象。請記住，過度勞累實際上會造成您和暗戀對象之間的距離。贏得某人的關鍵在於你的自信。深吸一口氣，記得腳踏實地；不要讓你的緊張成為焦點。
leo.horoscope_en: Leo, you might be experiencing some jitters today. If you have an important date on the horizon, your thoughts could be racing as you ponder how to leave a lasting impression. Keep in mind that overexerting yourself can actually create distance between you and your crush. The key to winning someone over lies in your self-assurance. Take a deep breath and remember to stay grounded; don’t let your nerves take center stage.

virgo.horoscope: 處女座，今天可能會給你帶來挑戰，因為你可能會發現自己很難達到目標。當你渴望取悅周圍的人時，你可能會感到壓力，必須做出一些不適合你的改變。這種不適感可能會升級為焦慮、激動甚至沮喪的感覺。請記住，現在承擔犧牲的重擔不是你的責任。
virgo.horoscope_en: Today might present challenges for you, Virgo, as you may find yourself struggling to hit the mark. In your desire to please those around you, you might feel pressured to make changes that don't sit well with you. This sense of discomfort could escalate into feelings of anxiety, agitation, and even frustration. Remember, it's not your responsibility to bear the burden of sacrifice right now.

libra.horoscope: 今天，天秤座，你可能會發現自己渴望日常生活中充滿魔法。您想引起某個特別的人的注意嗎？與其等待命運的介入，不如主動出擊！當您在熙熙攘攘的人群中發現那個有趣的人時，您會想要做好準備。當你度過美好的一天時，擁抱一種俏皮和快樂的精神。
libra.horoscope_en: Today, Libra, you might find yourself yearning for a touch of magic in your everyday life. Is there a special someone you'd like to catch the attention of? Instead of waiting for fate to intervene, take the initiative and make your move! When you spot that intriguing person in a bustling crowd, you'll want to be ready. Embrace a playful and joyful spirit as you navigate your day.

scorpio.horoscope: 天蠍座，今天你的直覺可能會增強，因為你的想像會隨著生動的場景而變得瘋狂。不要忽視這些願景；他們可能比你意識到的更真實。這是調整你內在聲音的絕佳時機，你的內心可以感知那些經常被別人忽略的微妙而重要的訊息。
scorpio.horoscope_en: Scorpio, your intuition is likely to be heightened today as your imagination runs wild with vivid scenarios. Don't dismiss these visions; they may hold more truth than you realize. It's an excellent time to tune into your inner voice, the part of you that can perceive those delicate yet significant messages that often go unnoticed by others.

sagittarius.horoscope: 射手座，今天表達你的想法可能會很有挑戰性。有些人可能會認為您的觀點過於關注自己，而有些人可能會發現您對他們的感受缺乏敏感性。努力真正傾聽周遭人的表達。您尋求的感情和認可可能不會如您所願。利用這段時間觀察你們的互動並獲得見解。
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Communicating your thoughts might prove challenging today, Sagittarius. Some may perceive your views as overly focused on yourself, while others might find you lacking in sensitivity to their feelings. Strive to truly listen to what those around you are expressing. It’s possible that the affection and recognition you seek may not come your way. Use this time to observe and gain insights from your interactions.

capricorn.horoscope: 今天，摩羯座，你可能會經歷一些情緒上的起伏，這可能會影響你富有想像的追求。重要的是要記住，您擁有實現這些夢想的力量。不要讓當天的情緒波動破壞您實現夢想的長期計劃。如果孤獨能帶給你安慰，那就給自己一些時間。繼續前進；堅持不懈是關鍵。
capricorn.horoscope_en: Today, Capricorn, you may experience some emotional ups and downs that could cloud your imaginative pursuits. It's essential to remember that you hold the power to cultivate these dreams. Don't allow the day's emotional fluctuations to derail your long-term plans for achieving your cherished aspirations. If solitude brings you comfort, take some time for yourself. Keep pushing forward; perseverance is key.

aquarius.horoscope: 水瓶座，你可能會注意到今天你圈子裡的人感覺有點敏感，所以在互動中要小心謹慎。他們擁有一種不可思議的能力，能夠看穿任何偽裝，並能迅速察覺到任何潛在的不和諧。坦率地表達你的想法很重要，無論你預期他們會如何接受。這種誠實的方法在特定情況下會對你很有幫助，尤其是因為無論如何，真相總有辦法暴露出來。
aquarius.horoscope_en: Aquarius, you may notice that those in your circle are feeling a bit sensitive today, so tread lightly in your interactions. They possess an uncanny ability to see through any pretense and can quickly sense any underlying discord. It's important to express your thoughts candidly, no matter how you anticipate they will be taken. This honest approach will serve you well in a particular situation, especially since the truth has a way of coming to light regardless.

pisces.horoscope: 在其他人可能正在經歷的混亂和不確定性中，雙魚座，你脫穎而出，成為清晰的燈塔。您處於獨特的位置，可以應對今天可能出現的充滿挑戰的環境。你的洞察力使你能夠穿透別人設置的防禦牆。沒有人能在你敏銳的洞察力面前隱藏他們的真實意圖。
pisces.horoscope_en: Amidst the chaos and uncertainty that others may be experiencing, Pisces, you stand out as a beacon of clarity. You're uniquely positioned to navigate the challenging circumstances that may unfold today. Your insight allows you to pierce through the facades that others put up as defenses. No one can hide their true intentions from your keen perception.
